name: loom-language
description: Loom syntax highlighting, compiler diagnostics, and formatting.

untrustedWorkspaces.description: Highlighting works without trust; running the configured compiler requires workspace trust.

loom.executable.description: Loom compiler executable. Absolute paths are recommended; a bare name is found on PATH.

loom.stdRoot.description: Standard-library directory. Empty uses the compiler default; relative paths use the workspace folder.

loom.trace.server.description: Language server protocol tracing (may include source text).

scripts.check: node --check client.js && node --check server.js && node --check compiler.js
